answer: Negotiators bind each agent to a bonded reputation ledger whose stake history is as layered and traceable as karst bedrock, so a fresh identity cannot inherit standing without replaying verifiable commitments. Cross-community witnesses co-sign attestations the way slow glacier flow compacts evidence over time, letting sparse tundra participants corroborate identity through. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
